name: Word of the Day

difficulty.rule: Pick words an educated adult is unlikely to know: rare, precise, mostly out of everyday use, but real entries in a major dictionary (Merriam-Webster, Oxford English Dictionary, Collins or Wiktionary). Harder than anything on a typical SAT or GRE list.

connection_rule: Each word should be at least loosely connected to the day's picture: the animal or object itself, what it does, where it lives, a sound or habit, a metaphor it suggests, or the origin of the word. A loose or poetic link is fine. Prefer a hard word with a real link over an easy word with an obvious one. Never force a link that is false or misleading.
avoid: words with only archaic or dialect forms you cannot confirm in a dictionary
proper nouns, brand names, abbreviations, and non-English words
words that are hard only because they are technical jargon of one narrow field, unless the definition is simple and interesting
